title: Debugging quantum circuits by circuit rewriting
access_note: OA full text not programmatically accessible. Route A (api.uspto.gov) HTTP 403 — requires free ODP API key from account.uspto.gov. Route B (OARD bulk, S3/PatentsView) HTTP 403 — access model changed; historically public S3 bucket now restricted. Route C (patentcenter.uspto.gov retrieval API) HTTP 405 — browser SPA only, not scrapeable. Route D (EPO OPS) HTTP 403 — fair use violation without OAuth token. Manual retrieval: patentcenter.uspto.gov → search application number → Documents/IFW tab → download CTNF/CTFR. One-command re-run once ODP API key obtained: curl -H 'X-API-KEY: <your_key>' 'https://api.uspto.gov/api/v1/patent/applications/15720814/documents'
